notes.title: Version 1.1 update with 5 new minigames!
notes.notes:
As always, you can unlock new games with the in game currency as you play over time, or if you have left over coins from before, all new games are sorted at the bottom of the shop.
Here's a sneak peak at 2 new ones:

Run away from a prehistoric apocalypse and dodge the stampede of dinosaurs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971565/c184ebb0c876aec37b3a46843b16960c94b48135.png[/img]

The might mouse cursor is angry! or just playing around? either way don't get hit against it's assortment of attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971565/343cc25ec4a4be23e05cf122a57cfbf26f7579bc.png[/img]

Happy gaming from the Ember Works team! :)
